name: com.icosafoundation.openbrushtoolkitdots
description:
This package contains Open Brush Toolkit features using Unity DOTS.

Features:

- Editor tool "Tilt Brush/Labs/Split Mesh By Stroke". You can use this tool to separate a mesh that contains multiple strokes into individual strokes. How to use: select one or more gameobjects that have stroke meshes, and activate the tool at Tilt Brush/Labs/Split Mesh By Stroke
